title: CAMS-AI-11e (bổ sung): Reasoning models response handling, token limit error, payload logging & reasoning_effort config
assumptions: reasoning_effort can be 'low', 'medium', 'high', or None for openai_compatible providers.
Groq / OpenAI-compat reasoning models: only extract delta.content (ignore reasoning/reasoning_content).
When finish_reason is 'length' and no content was emitted, raise user-friendly error suggesting increasing max_tokens.
Backend logs sanitized request body (no messages content, no API keys) on 400 Bad Request to enable easy comparison with working curl sample.
If provider returns 400 with reasoning_effort present, automatically retry without reasoning_effort.
